dialogue_text: Don't look up. This is not a drill. Missiles are inbound. Get to shelter now.
This is not a drill. Missiles are inbound. Get to shelter now. Where do we go?! Go! Down the stairs! Keep moving!
Go! Down the stairs! Keep moving!
Our defense AI, MERIDIAN, has turned on us. It launched the missiles. Jack! Cross says the machine did it! Don't believe him. Grab Lena. We're leaving. Now.
Don't believe him. Grab Lena. We're leaving. Now. Multiple inbound! Interceptors away! Bandit on my six! Going left!
Bandit on my six! Going left! Strikes confirmed on four continents. We're losing contact with...
Strikes confirmed on four continents. We're losing contact with...
Jack!
I see it! Hold on!
You came straight from the base. What did you see? Not now.
Jack... look at the sky.
Jack... look at the sky. Don't look. Don't look up. Keep your eyes on me.
The whole city just went dark.
Face down, Lena. Don't look up. Whatever you hear.
Stay down! Don't look up, no matter what! Dad!
Dad! Bring him back! Where did it take him? Eden. Cross's city. Every Collector belongs to him.

Eden. Cross's city. Every Collector belongs to him. They grab anyone who looks up. That red light locks onto your face. Nobody comes back. Three days after they take you, Eden wipes your mind. Forever.
Nobody comes back. Three days after they take you, Eden wipes your mind. Forever. It's three days' walk. Follow the light. Then I have three days.
Dad worked for Cross? He was a soldier the night the war started. He never talked about it. Find him, Lena. Ask him yourself.
He was a soldier the night the war started. He never talked about it. Find him, Lena. Ask him yourself. I will. And then I'm bringing him home.
Something's alive in here.
Nobody walks out here unless a Collector took someone.

Nobody walks out here unless a Collector took someone. My father. And a machine started the war. Why should I trust you? Because I know the way into Eden. I got out of it once. Then the sand covered me. Dig me out, and I'll take you to him.
Because I know the way into Eden. I got out of it once. Then the sand covered me. Dig me out, and I'll take you to him.
The moment I'm out of this sand, Cross's dogs will pick up my signal. We'll have one minute. You could have said that before I dug you out!
You could have said that before I dug you out! Then you wouldn't have. Great. A machine with jokes.
Aim for the legs. I know where to aim!
Then aim there.
Got one!
One more, on my back!
You saved me. I saved my guide. Don't make it weird. I'm Lena.
I saved my guide. Don't make it weird. I'm Lena. Lena. I've shut my signal off. No more dogs.
Why help me? What's in it for a machine? Cross wants me back. I want him to lose. Why does Cross want you?
Why does Cross want you? I used to repair his Collectors. Without me, they go blind. Get your father out first. Then I'll tell you the rest.
See that? Meridian. The AI that launched the missiles.
Billions of people. Gone. My mother didn't make it through the winter after. I'm sorry. Don't be sorry. Just don't ever be like it.
Don't be sorry. Just don't ever be like it.

Every night when I was little, Dad made me practice. Face in the dirt. Count to a hundred. You hated it. Every single night. Now it's the only reason I'm alive. He always said, find north, and I'll find you.
Every single night. Now it's the only reason I'm alive. He always said, find north, and I'll find you. He sounds like a good man. He is. And he's never kept a secret from me.
He is. And he's never kept a secret from me.
Don't move. Don't look. I know the rule. I grew up with it.
See that? They're failing. That's why he hunts me. Two days left. We leave at first light.
Voss. The robot is awake. Bring it to me intact. And the woman with it? She doesn't matter.
She doesn't matter. Understood, Mr. Cross.
Three riders. Cross's best.
Three riders. Cross's best. Hold on to something! Stop the truck. Give me the robot and you live.
Stop the truck. Give me the robot and you live.
Lena! Cut the cable!
Lena! Cut the cable!
Good. Come to me, machine.
Get in! Now! Go! Leave me! Get in the truck!
Hey! Get up! Please, get up!
Hey! Get up! Please, get up! I told you to leave me. And I didn't listen. Move!
And I didn't listen. Move! Jump on the back!
Jump on the back!
Lena, are you okay? Everything aches. We have to keep moving.
Everything aches. We have to keep moving. I lost them. Doesn't matter. I put a tracker on the woman.
They keep finding us. You're leading them to me!
Not me. Look at your shoulder. She put a tracker on me. It was me, not you.
She put a tracker on me. It was me, not you. You're scared. That's okay. Don't get used to it.
No truck now. How far to Eden? A day on foot. Through the drowned city. Then we walk all night if we have to. You're limping. We rest on that cliff.
You're limping. We rest on that cliff.
You lived in Eden. Is it really paradise? On top, yes. Towers, lights, food for everyone.
On top, yes. Towers, lights, food for everyone. Under the city, the people who looked up dig in Cross's mines. Forever. One day left. Then my father becomes one of them.
One day left. Then my father becomes one of them. Not if we're fast. Sleep now. You're only human. Says the machine.
Eden is on the other side of that city. Then we cross it.
That highway hasn't been safe for twenty years. Nothing has.
A bad storm is coming in from the sea.
A bad storm is coming in from the sea. Then we move faster. Once we're up there, there's no cover.
Once we're up there, there's no cover. So we don't stop.
Grab my hand! Don't you dare fall. I wasn't planning to.
I wasn't planning to. Oh no. Someone's waiting for us.
Oh no. Someone's waiting for us. This is the only road to Eden. So I waited here. Who are you?
Rhea Voss. I hunt for Mr. Cross. That robot is his. Why work for a man like him? I looked up when I was nine. He didn't wipe me. He gave me a home.
I looked up when I was nine. He didn't wipe me. He gave me a home. Now step aside. I only want the robot.
You've never been in a real fight, have you? There's a first time for everything.
Stop right there, machine. Or she pays for it.
Stop right there, machine. Or she pays for it. Let her go. Take me instead. Don't do it! Don't listen to her!
Get down, robot. Now.
The robot's in the sea. If it survives, it comes to Eden. I'll wait.
The robot's in the sea. If it survives, it comes to Eden. I'll wait.
You came back for me. I'm just a machine.
You came back for me. I'm just a machine. I don't leave anyone behind. Not even me? Especially you. You know the way to my father. That tower! Swim! Kick your legs!
That tower! Swim! Kick your legs! My leg's jammed. I'm slow. Then hold on to me.
We wait out the storm up there. Give me an hour to fix this leg.
Give me an hour to fix this leg.
E. Z. R. Four... Ezra. I'm calling you Ezra.
I've had a code number. Never a name. Well, now you've got one. Ezra. I like it.
Get under the water. Now!
Four hours left before they wipe Dad. Then we get inside Eden before dark. How?
You won't like it.
So what's the plan? First, you need to see the wall. Ezra, my dad doesn't have time for sightseeing. Trust me. You'll understand up there.
Trust me. You'll understand up there. Stay low. The wall has eyes.
There's no door in that wall.
There's one door. Only Collectors use it. The only way into Eden is in a Collector's hand.
The only way into Eden is in a Collector's hand. I hide in a cargo crate. You let a Collector take you. They scan for people, not metal. With my signal off, I'm just scrap.
Dad told me every day: don't look up. I know. Tonight, I'm going to look up.
I'm coming, Dad.
Come on! Take me!
You looked up on purpose. I watched you. My father's in there. I'm getting him out.
My father's in there. I'm getting him out. Nobody gets out. You're as lost as he is. Not yet.
This way. Quickly. That was too close. One is missing! Count again!
Where are we going? Up high. I need to see the whole city.
Welcome to Eden. Here, no one is hungry. No one is afraid.
Welcome to Eden. Here, no one is hungry. No one is afraid. Lena Cole. You came for your father. How touching. You have one hour. Then he forgets you forever.
You have one hour. Then he forgets you forever. He knows my name. The Collector scanned your face when you looked up. Run.
Down! Into the shaft! Where does it go? Under the city. To the mines.
These are the people who looked up. After the wipe, they don't even remember their names.
This is paradise? This? This is what pays for it.
Hold on! One's on the cart!
One's on the cart! Not anymore!
Did I just do that?
Did I just do that? You did. Remind me never to make you angry.
I hear the chairs humming. This is the wipe floor. Then Dad is in there.
I'll hold this door. Nothing gets past it while I'm here. Then don't let it.
Dad. Dad, it's me. Lena? No... You looked up? You told me never to. I did it to find you.
You told me never to. I did it to find you. That's my Lena.
Clever. I knew you'd bring my robot back to me.
Clever. I knew you'd bring my robot back to me. Here's a deal. Give me the robot, and your father walks free. Both of you. Out the gate. Tonight.
Both of you. Out the gate. Tonight.
Take the deal, Lena. I'm only a machine. Stop it.
Your father lives. That's why you came. No deal. He's not a thing. He's my friend.
She's right. Never make a deal with him. Then nobody leaves the mines. Not you. Not him.
Then nobody leaves the mines. Not you. Not him. This stair goes down to the cavern. Move!
And then what? Then we find another way up. That panel runs every collar down here.
That panel runs every collar down here.
Nobody leaves the mines. Watch me.
Where am I? Who am I?
Lena, behind you!
Lena, behind you! Ezra!
I'm... all right. You took that for me.
Enough. Mr. Cross wants all three of you upstairs. Your father's wipe can wait.
Dad. You know Cross, don't you?
Dad. You know Cross, don't you? Lena, whatever he tells you... What will he tell me? The truth. About me.
Sergeant Cole. Twenty-four years. Not long enough. You still wear that key.
How do you know my father? We were in the same room the night the war began.
He didn't tell you who he is?
He didn't tell you who he is? Your friend is Meridian. The machine that ended the world. Ezra... Tell me it isn't true.
Ezra... Tell me it isn't true. It's true. I never repaired his Collectors. I controlled them. I'm what's left of Meridian.
My mother is gone because of you!
I didn't launch the missiles. That night, I said no.
It's a machine, Lena. It'll say anything.
It's the truth. The machine refused to launch.
I was in that room, Lena. I know who did it.
Who? Him. Cross.
No strike is coming. Launch refused. Then we launch by hand. Turn your key, Sergeant! There's no strike, sir! I won't do it.
There's no strike, sir! I won't do it. Then I'll do it alone. And the machine takes the blame.
Then I'll do it alone. And the machine takes the blame.
I ran. I hid. I let the world blame a machine for twenty-four years.
The old world would never let me rule it. So I ended it. Every Collector runs on his mind. Since he left, they've been failing. I wipe him, he obeys me, and the truth is gone.
Every Collector runs on his mind. Since he left, they've been failing. I wipe him, he obeys me, and the truth is gone. No!
Nobody crosses until the bar is full.
Nobody crosses until the bar is full. Yes, sir. Dad. Give me a chance.
Dad. Give me a chance. You'll get one.
He saved me! He gave me a home!
He started the war! He took your home first!
Where did you learn to fight like that? On the way here. From you.
On the way here. From you. He fooled you too, Rhea. He fooled everyone.
He fooled you too, Rhea. He fooled everyone. Don't cut it. This chair is wired to every Collector.
Don't cut it. This chair is wired to every Collector. Let me jump into the Collectors before it erases me. I'll free them.
Then you'll be gone. No. I'll live in them. Thank you for my name, Lena.
No. I'll live in them. Thank you for my name, Lena.
It's over. The machine is finished.
Blue? No... no, no, no.
If Eden isn't mine, it's nobody's.
Not this time, Cross. All soldiers, stand down. He fooled us all.
All soldiers, stand down. He fooled us all.
Open the gate! Open it now! Gate opening.
Gate opening.
The moment I clear that wall, my missiles fall on Eden.
I'll come back for you. I promise.
I'll come back for you. I promise. Lena! Cross took his ship. He's going for the gate!
Then we stop him.
Lena, don't look up!
Lena, don't look up! It's okay, Dad. It's Ezra. Look at its eyes. Ezra? Take us to the gate. Stop Cross.
Ezra? Take us to the gate. Stop Cross.
We'll never catch a ship on foot! We don't have to. Ezra is in every Collector.
We don't have to. Ezra is in every Collector. Ezra! You're at the gate too! Stop him!
Let me go! I saved this world!
Let me go! I saved this world! You started the war, and you blamed a machine.
No more keys. No more wars. You have no idea what you've done.
I do. Now you look up.
I don't remember who I was. Then come up and find out. You're free.
Look... their eyes are blue. Look up. It's safe now.
I should have told you. Every day, I should have. Why didn't you?
Why didn't you? I was afraid you'd look at me the way the world looked at that machine. Look up, Dad. It's over.
You gave me a name, Lena. I'll never lose it.
You gave me a name, Lena. I'll never lose it. Dad's compass. So you always find your way back to us.
Dad's compass. So you always find your way back to us. Get some sleep, Lena. You're only human.
Says the machine. For twenty-four years, we were told a machine started the war.
For twenty-four years, we were told a machine started the war. A machine didn't start the war. A man did. The machine said no.
A machine didn't start the war. A man did. The machine said no. Twenty-four years... I forgot what the sky looked like. You can look up now.
You can look up now.
Daniel... it's me. It's okay. I'll remember for both of us.
What now?
Now we build a world where no one has to hide their face.
Lena... there's another Eden.
And its machine just said yes to launch.
And its machine just said yes to launch.
